issues.description: Element: Lecture constructor. Problem statement and UML require the constructor parameter order to follow the UML attribute order: lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors. The solution implementation defines the constructor as: Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents). This mismatch between the required parameter order (problem statement/UML) and the implemented parameter order (solution) will confuse students and can break tests or examples that expect the UML order.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the constructor parameter order in the solution implementation with the UML and problem statement. Change the solution constructor signature to: public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors) and assign the fields accordingly. If the implemented order was intentional, update the problem statement and UML to document the implemented order instead.

issues.description: Constructor parameter order mismatch: the exercise (UML and instructions) expects a Lecture constructor with parameters in this order: lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors. The solution implementation defines the constructor as: Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents). Students reading the problem/UML will implement or expect the constructor parameters in the UML order, but the solution's constructor uses a different ordering (lecturers/tutors before inscribed/guest students). This inconsistency can confuse students and break graders or tests that validate the constructor signature or rely on argument order.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the solution constructor to match the UML and problem statement parameter order. Use the signature: public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors) and assign fields accordingly (this.lectureName = lectureName; this.numberOfInscribedStudents = numberOfInscribedStudents; this.numberOfGuestStudents = numberOfGuestStudents; this.numberOfLecturers = numberOfLecturers; this.numberOfTutors = numberOfTutors).
